items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: I ran into Miff one day at NBC when we were doing some studio work

ctx.x: Yeah, and other than that I heard Henry Bussey who played with Whiteman and the trombone player and that was all 'waka waka do' a lot of that and the growl like -- I ran into Miff one day at NBC when we were doing some studio work and he come down from some rehearsal and looks at me with those big watery eyes through his glasses, and said, 'Well, I guess the growl is here to stay.' Typical Miff observation.
Well, there was a lot of that --
